feeds.title: Ellis Tuesday
feeds.description: Ellis Tuesday is a beauty, fashion & lifestyle blog brought to you by Ellis, a self-confessed shopaholic from Scotland with an overwhelming stash of beauty products and a love for all things leopard print. A blog about beauty, travel, lifestyle, and fashion from a twenty-something Glasgow girl.

feeds.title: Glasgow Beauty Blogger
feeds.description: Glasgow Beauty Blogger is a Scottish beauty and lifestyle blog written by Lori, a Glasgow girl, qualified makeup artist and hedgehog mother.Here you'll find the latest beauty must-haves, some old favourites and the odd makeup tutorial.

feeds.title: The Black Pearl Blog
feeds.description: My name is Sandra, I am 34. I am married and I am a mother to Zachary (10) and Mia (6). I decided to start The Black Pearl Blog to share my passion for skincare, make-up, fashion, photography, interior design and DIY projects, and in the past 10 years, blogging became a big part of my life.

feeds.title: Beauty Balm
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sandra and love beauty! I will mainly be blogging about beauty but also other things that interest me.

feeds.title: Deerieo Blog
feeds.description: Deerieo News is blog by a Scottish natural skincare brand sharing their brand development journey, skincare tips and routines from the founder to give you the best no-fuss skincare routine and glowing skin out there.

feeds.title: Nicole Corbett
feeds.description: My name is Nicole and I am a beauty, lifestyle and advice blogger based here in Scotland. I love helping others, and hope that my posts can inspire and help others!
